name: Loose Parts
long_description:
Loose Parts is an all new dance-music project inspired by live broken beats, jungle and liquid funk music non-stop all throughout the night! Taking inspiration from classic dance floor rhythms and sounds, they will be putting their own spin on club and DJ music via the form of a live band, steeped in jazz and improvisation.

Loose Parts consists of:

Alex Vujanic - saxophone and samples
Jamin Forlong - guitar
Sam Hunter - keyboard
Tyaan Singh - bass
Ateo Buhne - drums

Music from 9:30pm, FREE ENTRY - Koha for the band appreciated!

long_description:

id: Rogue And Vagabond Presents: AJA Live-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Rogue And Vagabond Presents: AJA Live
long_description:
AJA LIVE AT ROGUE

AJA is an award-winning Māori artist weaving soul, R&B and te ao Māori into a sound distinctly her own.

Following the release of her debut album Kāwai, AJA has been busy on stages across Aotearoa - touring with L.A.B, performing with Fly My Pretties, and featuring on their latest album alongside some of Aotearoa’s finest musicians.

Now she brings it home to Pōneke for something a little closer.

For one intimate night at Rogue & Vagabond, AJA & friends take the stage with a live band sharing waiata from Kāwai, familiar favourites and a few special moments along the way.

Setting the tone for the night are b0iLupATmiNE & Mlkbdgr on the decks.

No big production. Just good music, good people and live waiata in the heart of Pōneke.

AJA & Friends
b0iLupATmiNE & Mlkbdgr on the decks

Rogue & Vagabond, Pōneke
Saturday 24 October
Door sales

id: Sunday Jazz - Arturo Baez/Blair Latham Quartet-The Rogue & Vagabond-Rogue & Vagabond
name: Sunday Jazz - Arturo Baez/Blair Latham Quartet
long_description:
Arturo Baez / Blair Latham Quartet w/ Tyson Smith (gtr), Rick Cranson (dms) and special guest Anton Wuts (sax)

Arturo and Blair began their musical journey together when Blair moved to Mexico
City in 2010 and became an integral part of the jazz and improv scenes. Both being
in demand players, they were inevitably thrown together in many of the top
creative projects that performed at the main jazz clubs of the day (El Zinco,
Jazzatlan, Jazzorca). Since Blair moved back to NZ in 2014 they have maintained a strong musical connection, and look forward to sharing their original compositions and improvisations played with local legends Tyson and Rick with New Zealand audiences.

Arturo Báez is a Mexican double bassist and electric bassist whose music moves between jazz, free improvisation and spontaneous collective creation. For more than 15 years, he has been an active presence in Mexico’s improvised music scene, collaborating with internationally acclaimed artists including Ken Vandermark, Joe Morris, Chris Corsano, Michael Zerang, Sam Newsome and Isaiah Collier. His international work includes performances at the No Idea Festival in Austin and across the United States, Europe and Asia. He is a member of the Remi Álvarez Trio and leads Otrora un Simulacro, an original jazz ensemble that features his compositions.

Music from 5pm, FREE ENTRY - Koha for the band appreciated
